CVE-2025-8844.title: A vulnerability was determined in NASM Netwide Assember 2.17rc0.  ...
CVE-2025-8844.description: A vulnerability was determined in NASM Netwide Assember 2.17rc0. This vulnerability affects the function parse_smacro_template of the file preproc.c. The manipulation leads to null pointer dereference. Attacking locally is a requirement. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.
